newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Thirsty jaguar procures water for Bulgarian zoo.
newsitem.headline: Thirsty jaguar procures water for Bulgarian zoo.

text.p: Victor the Parrot kept shrieking "Voda, Voda" -- "Water, Water".

But it was the constant, fearsome roaring of Michael the Jaguar that got water supplies to the Dobrich zoo turned on again after a thirsty week for 130 animals, the Sofia newspaper Troud reported on Friday.

A broken pipe clocked up a huge bill which the northern Bulgarian town's zoo could not pay, the paper said. The state-owned water company cut off supplies and was deaf to all pleas until Michael began to roar.
